verdict.rationale: pnpm's core `install` command resolves and installs all declared dependencies from a single lockfile, with automatic frozen-lockfile mode in CI (pnpm-docs-13) and drop-in npm compatibility with no lockfile gymnastics (pnpm-docs-2,17). Community testimonials corroborate fast, reliable one-command installs on fresh clones/migrations (pnpm-comm-5,10,14,17), though some report edge-case friction (peer-dep auto-install, symlink quirks) (pnpm-comm-7,8,16). Missing for 10: independent benchmark/hands-on verification specifically of a fresh-clone bootstrap scenario, and no first-party doc explicitly framing 'one command for a fresh clone' as a named workflow.
